vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2021-0127
vulnerability.description: serde_cbor is unmaintained (informational advisory, not a vulnerability; there is no patched version)

statements.impact_statement: Informational unmaintained-crate notice, not a vulnerability: serde_cbor is a build-graph dependency of pgrx 0.19 (pgrx's direct dependency, not edtf's), tracked upstream as pgcentralfoundation/pgrx#524. The same rationale is enforced in deny.toml, where the ignore is guarded (unused-ignored-advisory = "deny") so this record fails the build the moment pgrx drops serde_cbor and cannot go stale. No other advisories are known against any edtf crate.
